build_lstm_discriminator: build an LSTM discriminator network that operates on word index sequences for GAN text discrimination
create_discriminator_with_embeddings: create an LSTM discriminator with pretrained embeddings from an external embedding source and vocab file
run_discriminator_forward_pass: run the LSTM discriminator forward pass on a batch of word index sequences to get per-timestep logits
review_lstm_discriminator_architecture: review the LSTM discriminator architecture using deep RNN cells with layer normalization and positional encoding
test_discriminator_masking: test the discriminator masking logic that zeros out logits past the first PAD token in sequences
